blocks.html: An ADU shall be provided with a heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning system, electrical system, and gas piping in accordance with Section U103.5.1 through U103.5.4, provided that an ADU on a tax lot where the total number of dwelling units exceeds 2, other than an ADU constructed in accordance with section U202, shall be provided with a heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning system, electrical system, and gas piping that is separate from the primary dwelling.
